Thank you for taking the time to send a change.

**We do not accept pull requests yet**, so this one will be closed. This is not about the quality of your change: the project is young, its design still moves quickly, and we are not yet set up to review outside code and handle the rights to it.

What helps instead: open an issue that describes the problem and your fix in words. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/A1exZabr/apiunicon/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

Security problems go through [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/A1exZabr/apiunicon/blob/main/SECURITY.md), never into a public issue or pull request.
